acceptanceCriteria: `consequence_case` treats a `plan.unknown` entry with reason `NO_SELECTABLE_TEST` whose detail names the package of an expected test as coverage of that expectation, and the rule is recorded in the harness docstring and BUILD-LOG.
If the preregistration text fixes the scoring rule, the change is recorded as a preregistration amendment with a new digest before any run uses it.
The five run-001 UC-CHANGE-CONSEQUENCE critical misses re-score as covered against a build containing AFP-V0-020, and a run against the pre-fix build still reports them as misses.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from the V1-0187 review. `benchmarks/daily-loop-v0/harness.py` `consequence_case` (about lines 249-261) credits only `plan.selected`, so a changed Go package that AFP-V0-020 now names in `plan.unknown` with reason `NO_SELECTABLE_TEST` still scores as a critical miss. The V1-0187 criterion 2 re-run (a sealed daily-loop run after PRs #108 and #110 merge) cannot credit the fix until the harness reads `plan.unknown`. The preregistration digest is 73f178f8b1bcaaa57115c2ee9389f3a57fa3d889ee6e8a50035edeec3ae04b9d; check whether the scoring rule is part of the preregistered text before changing it.
title: daily-loop harness: score `plan.unknown` NO_SELECTABLE_TEST entries in `consequence_case`
